data.title: 中野一花 · 温泉雾气中的温软回眸
data.description: 露天温泉池畔热气缭绕，雪白浴巾贴合着湿润曼妙的身姿。一花微微侧身回首，锁骨挂着晶莹水珠，娇羞而迷人。
data.action: soaking in onsen, looking over shoulder, steam rising
data.lighting: soft lantern glow through rising steam
data.promptProse: Soaking peacefully in a secluded cedar onsen under night lantern light, Nakano Ichika looks over her bare shoulder through rising mist. A white bath towel is wrapped around her body. Clear warm water ripples around her collarbones as gentle water droplets glisten on her delicate skin.
data.animaCaption: Turning back in the steamy outdoor onsen pool, water droplets glisten on her flushed skin under lantern glow.
